National Board of Revenue: This is the government authority responsible for issuing this notification regarding customs matters.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: এস.আর.ও. নং- ১৬১-আইন/২০১৩/২৪৪৮/কাস্টমস—Customs Act, 1969 (Act IV of 1969) এর section 13 এর উদ্দেশ্য পূরণকল্পে, এবং section 219 এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড, বন্ডেড ওয়্যারহাউস লাইসেন্সিং বিধিমালা, ২০০৮ এর নিম্নরূপ অধিকতর সংশোধন করিল, যথা :-

Customs Act 1969: This act serves as the foundational authority, specifically through sections 13 and 219, for the issuance and amendment of customs-related licensing regulations by the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The board acts as the regulatory authority empowered to issue and amend statutory rules governing customs procedures, including the licensing of bonded warehouses.
Bonded Warehouse Licensing Rules 2008: These rules are subject to further amendment by the National Board of Revenue under the powers granted by the Customs Act 1969 to regulate the operation and licensing of bonded warehouses.
